verdict.rationale: The only programmatic interface in evidence is the official Thoropass MCP server. It can list evidence requests and add comments, attachments, and status updates to them, which offers a narrow, AI-assistant-mediated way to push evidence. The integrations pages describe only auditor-vetted native integrations from a catalog, with no developer-facing API for building private connectors. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API, custom/private integration support, a way to push automated test results into monitors, API auth/reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
